ops.body:
RE-CONFIRMED 2026-08-29, on captain-hook 12.22.4 + daemonkit v0.23.0, Homebrew 6.0.20-54-gb42173b, macOS 26.6.2. Thirty-four days after this note was filed, on TWO hosts, byte-for-byte the same failure. It cost a full diagnosis cycle before anyone read the log the failure was already written into.

yasyf-box, from ~/Library/Logs/Homebrew/captain-hook/post_install.01.capt-hookd.log:

  2026-08-29 19:08:45 -0700
  /opt/homebrew/Cellar/captain-hook/12.22.4/libexec/Captain Hook.app/Contents/Helpers/capt-hookd
  package-install

  captain package: activate installed app: deploy: apply agent "com.yasyf.capt-hook.helper":
  launchd: install agent "com.yasyf.capt-hook.helper": launchd: write agent plist:
  open /Users/yasyf/Library/LaunchAgents/.com.yasyf.capt-hook.helper.plist.545221131: operation not permitted

yasyf-forge-studio, same log, same day, same Homebrew build:

  2026-08-29 17:57:06 -0700
  ... open /Users/yasyf/Library/LaunchAgents/.com.yasyf.capt-hook.helper.plist.4074401208: operation not permitted

The sandbox rules are now pinned to a source line: Homebrew wraps post_install at /opt/homebrew/Library/Homebrew/formula_installer.rb:1476-1489, granting writes only to the formula's logs, Xcode, the Cellar rack/etc/var, temp+cache, and HOMEBREW_PREFIX/<link dirs>. ~/Library/LaunchAgents is not among them and cannot be added from the formula side. Nothing about this has changed or can change below the packaging layer — the note's original conclusion holds unmodified.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERION 2 CONFIRMED STILL TRUE, and it is the expensive half. `capt-hook helper install` (captain_hook/helper/cli.py:23-35) runs `brew install --formula`, which no-ops with "already installed and up-to-date" on a current Cellar and therefore never reaches post_install at all — then unconditionally prints "Captain Hook installed." Four separate repair attempts (kickstart -k, `capt-hook update run`, `capt-hook helper install`, `brew reinstall` + `helper install`) all reported success while the deployed app sat at 12.21.3 from Aug 16. The formula caveat still advertises this verb as the repair path.

WORKING PATH RE-PROVEN, unchanged from this note:

  HOME=/Users/yasyf "/opt/homebrew/Cellar/captain-hook/12.22.4/libexec/Captain Hook.app/Contents/Helpers/capt-hookd" package-install

One wrinkle worth recording for the next operator: on a machine with a live host, the FIRST run refuses with `deploy: live processes remain on the deployment's executables` while its own quiesce is still taking those processes down. That refusal is a race against the inventory snapshot, not a real blocker — re-run immediately and it exits 0. Converged yasyf-box end to end: app 12.22.4, helper `v12.22.4 ok=True`, host pid 60234 status 0, fresh ~/.daemonkit/a/com.yasyf.captain-hook.host.v1/ with a live daemon.sock.

TWO SPIN-OFFS FILED, because they are distinct defects rather than restatements of this one:
- The HOME-resolution split, which changed this bug's failure mode from loud to silent (see the sibling bug titled "installedApplicationPath resolves the app root from $HOME while daemonkit resolves agents from the passwd DB").
- The updater's false success reporting (see the sibling bug on updater.py:118-120).

FLEET STATUS AS OF THIS COMMENT: yasyf-box converged to 12.22.4. yasyf-forge-studio is STILL UNCONVERGED — its Cellar is 12.22.4 while its deployed app is 12.22.3 (activation.json version 12.22.3, bundle mtime 2026-08-28 10:41:55), and its host at launchctl status 0 is running that older release. It needs the same two-step remedy.
